title: sorbus mayeri
intro: Sorbus mayeri, commonly known as the Tibetan Rowan, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus mayeri include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit cytotoxic effects against certain pathogens. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
